content: Read user defined memory by status mask authentication check On reception of the UDS Service ReadDTCInformation (0x19) with sub- function reportUserDefMemoryDTCByStatusMask (0x17), the Dcm shall check if the access to the selected user defined memory in parameter MemorySelection is authen- ticated and read the DTC information only if: • a DcmDspReadDTCInformationUserDefinedFaultMemoryRole is con- figured with DcmDspReadDTCInformationUserDefinedFaultMemory- RoleId matching the MemorySelection and the verification according to [SWS_Dcm_01479] was successful or • the active white list on that connection has for that requested user defined mem- ory selection one entry.
